Buffalo Supply, Inc.
(often referenced in medical distribution contexts alongside specialty federal and hospital logistics) connects
medical equipment and device manufacturers to healthcare systems and the federal marketplace
Major Manufacturer Partners
Smith+Nephew:
Orthopedic portfolios, including knee/hip replacement systems, trauma devices, and bone deformity correction tools.
STERIS:
Long-term partner providing infection prevention, surgical, and sterilization systems.
Boston Scientific / AMS Men's Health:
Urological and pelvic health specialty therapeutic devices (e.g., AMS 700, AMS 800).
Integra LifeSciences:
Neurosurgery, reconstructive wound care, and surgical instrumentation.
Arch Therapeutics:
Specialized medical devices and wound-care material innovations.
LinkedIn
Key Product Categories & Brands
Orthopedics & Implants:
Cemented and cementless knee and hip replacement hardware.
Surgical & Critical Care:
Operating room instrumentation, neurosurgery monitoring systems, and wound management matrix products.
Urology Devices:
Erectile restoration and male urinary continence control systems.
Infection Prevention & Sterilization:
Hospital-grade sterilization equipment and sterile processing accessories.
